entities.summary: Vittorio Emanuele Taparelli d'Azeglio was a political leaders in Turin (1816-09-17, Turin – 1890-04-24), a notable figure of the Modern era. Their work intersected with political systems and governance and geopolitical linkage and diplomacy. Shaped political institutions and governance practices.
